purpose: One coherent versioned understanding of real projects, financing, components, organizations, E&S commitments, evidence and performance. Institutional templates are derived views and validation inputs, never master schemas.

deliverableIndex.contractVerificationReceipt: docs/lifecycle-architecture/contract-validation.json; current artifact digests and explicit runtime/proposed/historical scope limits

existingAuthorities.reuse: Canonical UUID identity + explicit accountId/projectId links. Existing identity publicReferences and descriptive stakeholder/lifecycle metadata remain in place.

existingAuthorities.store: account-local workspace.sqlite projects JSON + private locations + retained objects
existingAuthorities.reuse: Existing project IDs, workspace IDs, resources, version descriptors, source bytes, source derivations and portable project envelopes.

existingAuthorities.store: personal_projects identity_id/project_id/profile_json and existing per-project vault
existingAuthorities.reuse: Personal project remains a separate existing custody facet; ledger does not reinterpret personal files as account ownership.

existingAuthorities.store: Existing engagement tables + authenticated engagement object authority
existingAuthorities.reuse: Mandates, requirements, assertions, findings, actions, obligations, approvals, mappings, publications, monitoring programs/cycles/obligations/submissions/requests/indicators/measurements/missions/events/verifications, baselines and audit.

existingAuthorities.store: Existing verified identity/resource-grant and mutation transaction authority
existingAuthorities.reuse: Current account/resource authorization, case restrictions and protected-source closure. New local ledger has no hosted authority implementation claim.

existingAuthorities.store: Versioned framework catalogue + retained exact policy originals and engagement requirement definitions
existingAuthorities.reuse: Existing review prompts remain clearly labeled; proposed authoritative Requirement edition records reference retained exact sources.

Business context, namespaced ResourceReference, immutable DocumentVersionLink and safe portable JSON. Studio Project manifest describes software/project workspace policy, not the real-world investment Project master.

limitedSlice.authority: Additive account-owned business-context extension referencing existing authorities
limitedSlice.currentPersistence: Additive account-local project-lifecycle.sqlite: lifecycle_ledgers, lifecycle_verifications and lifecycle_restore_receipts. It does not replace source-project or engagement persistence.
limitedSlice.businessApproval: Separate immutable ledger snapshot; never an assessment/compliance approval or access grant. Local verification receipts bind exact records; imported verification claims are retained history and cannot authorize a fresh approval.
limitedSlice.deployment: Local loopback account context only; hosted route, physical relational replacement and cloud migration remain proposed.
limitedSlice.profileInterpretation: JSON Schema defines portable shape and selected bounds. The implemented local profile additionally enforces smaller operational limits and current-authority/graph/hash checks. A schema-valid value does not bypass these local limits.

proposedOnly: Institutional report adapters beyond demonstrated slice
implementationBoundary.demoVersusAuthority: Scenario fixtures are isolated acceptance data, not retained real project records or verified institutional compliance. UI previews/derived reports are views. Proposed $defs do not enable new runtime collections.
explicitNonGoals: No full E&S runtime graph rewrite or blanket migration.
No new source/evidence authority or rewriting existing approved assessment snapshots.
No native institutional reporting/template-compliance claim from institution-labeled views.
No automatic framework applicability, crosswalk compliance transfer or AI sign-off.
No hosted lifecycle endpoints, managed relational/spatial deployment or event transport.
No hosted worker, queue consumer, recurring schedule or live/AWS call.

ProjectComponent.definition: Physical or functional project component, optionally nested or an associated facility. Associated facilities are explicit relationships, never implicit shared ownership.

Site.definition: Spatially located operational or study area; detailed geometry remains a versioned spatial source.

Activity.definition: A time-bounded undertaking such as site clearing, construction, operation or decommissioning. Optional sectorProfileId links the existing application sector profile only after manual business verification; it is neither an institutional risk category nor a compliance/applicability conclusion.

Organization.definition: Named legal or institutional organization, including financiers, funds, intermediaries, operators and community bodies. Descriptive organization identity grants no account access.

OrganizationRoleAssignment.definition: Effective-dated business role linking an organization to explicit project, component, investment, facility or agreement scopes. Separate from professional assignment and access grants.

Investment.definition: Investor economic interest that may target an organization, fund or intermediary; allocations independently connect its amount to one or several project/component identities.

FinancialFacility.definition: Contractual financing envelope distinct from Investment and from individual financial transactions; supports parent facilities and credit lines.

Transaction.definition: One dated financial commitment, flow or reversal; retains original money and currency without silently converting totals.

FinancingParticipant.definition: Organization participation in a particular facility, permitting separate lenders and financiers with distinct roles, shares and commitments.

InvestmentAllocation.definition: Normalized many-to-many allocation of an Investment across projects and optionally components. Amount or share is explicit; unallocated balances and currency conversions remain visible.

Agreement.definition: Versioned contract connecting parties, projects and facilities; sourceVersions pin exact retained contract editions and amendments.

Covenant.definition: Agreement obligation with its exact source passage and links to existing requirements and monitoring obligations. A covenant record does not make a compliance finding.

EngagementScope.definition: Structured scope overlay for an existing professional Engagement across project parts and periods. Existing mandates, roles and sources remain authoritative.

RequirementApplicability.definition: Explicit professional applicability decision for a pinned existing requirement/framework edition at project, component, financing, agreement and temporal scope. Never inherited through a crosswalk.

LifecycleEvent.definition: Lifecycle stage or milestone referencing existing engagement, monitoring cycle, incident/event, action and approved baseline records. Does not copy observations, facts or compliance conclusions.

Project.definition: Projection of the existing real-world Project identity; business references never create a second project authority.

Engagement.definition: Projection reference to existing contractual professional mandate, independent of financing and project identity.

Deliverable.definition: Structured expected professional output; implementation initially maps existing engagement mandate deliverables and obligation/publication records.

Risk.definition: Uncertain potential adverse environmental or social event or condition; preserve inherent and residual risk separately.

Impact.definition: Expected or observed change to a receptor caused by an activity, distinguishing adverse and beneficial impacts.

Receptor.definition: Environmental or social receptor such as habitat, water body, workers, community or cultural asset; do not expose sensitive coordinates in public views.

StakeholderGroup.definition: Affected or interested group with scoped vulnerability characterization; individual identities remain in restricted case storage.

BaselineCondition.definition: Dated, sourced description of a receptor before change; keep season, method and uncertainty explicit.

ManagementPlan.definition: Versioned management instrument linking risks, requirements, measures, responsibilities and resources.

ManagementMeasure.definition: One mitigation or enhancement measure in the mitigation hierarchy with owner, schedule, budget and verification criteria.

FrameworkEdition.definition: Versioned attributable institutional framework or statutory instrument, independent of report-template editions.

Requirement.definition: Attributable requirement or explicitly labeled review prompt; existing retained catalogue definitions remain authoritative for current engagements.

RequirementCrosswalk.definition: Reviewed versioned mapping between exact requirement editions. Relationships describe meaning and never propagate applicability or compliance conclusions.

Study.definition: Study metadata and scope referencing existing original document editions; field methods and limitations are explicit.

EvidenceAssertion.definition: Reference projection of existing engagement assertion. A source statement and its reliability are separate from the project fact or assessor judgment it may support.

Observation.definition: Directly recorded dated observation without a professional conclusion; retains original field/measurement evidence and QA state.

ProfessionalJudgment.definition: Attributable assessor interpretation using explicit evidence, contradictions, rubric and uncertainty. AI proposals cannot sign or establish a conclusion.

ProjectFact.definition: Scoped proposition explicitly established by an authorized human on retained evidence; retains disputed or corrected predecessor without erasure.

Indicator.definition: Typed environmental or social indicator definition. Thresholds and outcome targets retain source and period; cross-project aggregation requires comparable units and denominators.

IndicatorMeasurement.definition: Dated site and period value for an indicator with sampling method, worker class, uncertainty, QA and exact source evidence.

SocialOutcome.definition: Measured social result against a specified baseline and affected group, without inferring causality from a trend.

Grievance.definition: Restricted case metadata with receipt, acknowledgment, response, appeal and closure; individual content is held by existing restricted case authority.

IncidentNotification.definition: Notice sent to a specifically identified recipient under a sourced reporting obligation; timestamps do not infer that another recipient was notified.

Incident.definition: Existing restricted E&S event with occurrence, awareness and per-recipient notification times; redacted public metadata never expose victims or sensitive geometry.

Assessment.definition: Repeated or overlapping professional evaluation over an explicit scope and period with pinned requirement editions, sources and immutable approved baseline.

AssessmentFinding.definition: Projection reference of existing engagement finding; applicability, evidence coverage, adequacy and performance remain distinct judgments.

CorrectiveAction.definition: Projection/extension of existing action with responsible organization, linked deficiencies, deadlines, budget, dependencies and evidence-based verification.

Commitment.definition: Project promise arising from a plan, consultation or contract, independently tracked from the corrective action used to deliver it.

Verification.definition: Projection reference of existing independent verification against explicit criteria, retained closure evidence and authorized reviewer.

Approval.definition: Existing authorized professional process decision tied to a fixed content revision/hash. Business-context approval is separately typed and does not imply assessment approval.

MonitoringProgram.definition: Existing monitoring program reusing its approved assessment baseline, requirements, indicators, actions and obligations.

MonitoringCycle.definition: Existing periodic supervision cycle; cycles can overlap but remain independently reviewed against exact periods and baseline snapshots.

Report.definition: Issued existing publication rendition or proposed template view of exact baseline content; rendering never becomes a second record authority.

ConsultationEvent.definition: Dated meaningful engagement and disclosure event retaining accessibility, SEP deviations, feedback and responses without publishing personal identities.

PortfolioExposure.definition: Dated original-currency intermediary/fund exposure by product and sector, retaining estimated status and denominator before aggregation.

Entitlement.definition: Eligibility and benefit owed under an exact approved resettlement/compensation instrument; personal roster stays restricted.

EntitlementDelivery.definition: Scheduled and actual entitlement delivery with retained evidence and human verification; payment does not establish livelihood restoration.

LivelihoodOutcome.definition: Longitudinal livelihood result relative to baseline with subgroup disaggregation and attribution limitations.

SourcePassage.definition: Exact passage in the existing retained original. OCR/extracted candidates must preserve derivative identity and original-page review in existing extraction binding. Quote hashing does not prove meaning or professional sufficiency.

ExactSourceVersion.definition: Locator into existing project resource/version authority. Verify project/resource/version closure and full-object SHA256 before use. The version remains owned by its existing authority; no file bytes, local paths, signed URLs or grants appear here.

ProjectBinding.definition: References existing account project and explicit real-world identity link. No project title or parallel project authority.

FinancialExit.definition: A financier exits an investment; distinct from operational shutdown, project closure or completion of long-term obligations.

ApprovedBusinessContext.definition: Immutable approved ledger snapshot separate from all professional E&S approvals.

relationships.name: identity_custody
relationships.integrity: Existing explicit project_identity_links governs linkage. A name, institution identifier or account association cannot merge identities or confer access.

relationships.name: project_components
relationships.integrity: Component belongs to exactly one current account Project; project must have an explicit real-world identity link.

relationships.name: component_hierarchy
relationships.integrity: Acyclic hierarchy, no self-parent; parent and child must share projectId. Associated facility relationship is explicit and distinct from containment.

relationships.name: associated_facility
relationships.integrity: Only kind=associated_facility may link another Project. Link does not imply ownership, funding allocation or another project access grant.

relationships.name: project_sites
relationships.integrity: Every site belongs to one current Project. Its component IDs must belong to that Project.

relationships.name: component_sites
relationships.integrity: Normalized ComponentSite relationship in a future relational implementation; empty means project-wide or unresolved, never infer a component.

relationships.name: project_activities
relationships.integrity: Activity component and sites must be in its project.

relationships.name: organization_roles
relationships.integrity: Each assignment has one organization and at least one structured scope, effective dates and independent provenance. Role is descriptive, never an authorization grant.

relationships.name: organization_investments
relationships.integrity: Both ends resolve to explicit Organization IDs. Investor and investee identity are not derived from institution names.

relationships.name: fund_subinvestments
relationships.integrity: Acyclic economic chain supports fund/intermediary/subinvestment. Project identity and financing chain are independent; never count parent and child twice in a portfolio total.

relationships.name: investment_projects
relationships.integrity: Each allocation has one Investment and one Project, optionally a component of that project. Amount or share required; partial/unallocated balances preserved.

relationships.name: investment_transactions
relationships.integrity: Each Transaction is dated, typed, status-bearing and denominated in explicit original currency. Reversal history is append-only.

relationships.name: facility_transactions
relationships.integrity: Referenced facility is explicit; optional facility does not mean a fabricated facility can be inferred.

relationships.name: facility_hierarchy
relationships.integrity: No cycles or self-parent; parent/child commitments are not automatically additive.

relationships.name: facility_borrower
relationships.integrity: Borrower is separate from all participating financiers and from the project owner.

relationships.name: facility_financiers
relationships.integrity: Each participation has one organization + facility + role, effective dates and optional share/commitment. Multiple lenders and roles supported.

relationships.name: agreement_parties
relationships.integrity: Future AgreementParty join; party roles can use scoped OrganizationRoleAssignment. A historical agreement retains exact party IDs and source versions.

relationships.name: agreement_projects
relationships.integrity: One contract can cover multiple existing Projects; no parallel Project records.

relationships.name: facility_agreements
relationships.integrity: One logical AgreementFacility edge with reciprocal exchange views; validate consistency rather than store conflicting authorities.

relationships.name: agreement_covenants
relationships.integrity: Each covenant belongs to one agreement. Source passage must identify an exact retained edition; amendment changes create a new revision.

relationships.name: project_engagement_scopes
relationships.cardinality: 1 : 0..* through scopes; each current Engagement belongs to one project
relationships.integrity: Multiple or overlapping mandates reuse one Project. Existing engagement projectId must equal scope projectId. Existing current implementation has one project per engagement; future cross-project mandate requires explicit shared contract evolution.

relationships.name: engagement_deliverables
relationships.integrity: Map existing mandate.deliverables and obligations/publications with an explicit promotion map; do not duplicate approved mandate content.

relationships.name: framework_requirements
relationships.integrity: Every requirement belongs to one exact edition. Parent requirements remain in the same edition and are acyclic.

relationships.name: requirement_applicability
relationships.integrity: Pinned requirement edition and professional rationale scoped independently to project/component/financing/agreement/time; no applicability inference from financing alone.

relationships.name: requirement_crosswalk
relationships.integrity: Directed edition-specific relationship. equivalent/overlapping/broader/narrower/related/conflicting never transfers compliance decisions.

relationships.name: assessment_findings
relationships.integrity: Repeated/overlapping assessments refer to exact scoped requirement versions and evidence. Approved finding content stays in the original engagement baseline.

relationships.name: assertion_source
relationships.integrity: Existing implementation assertion uses one exact original and quote/locator. Multiple passages require multiple assertions or a future grouped claim, never a silent source overwrite.

relationships.name: finding_evidence
relationships.integrity: Retain support and contradictions separately with professional dispositions. Retrieval matches are not evidence assertions.

relationships.name: observation_evidence
relationships.integrity: Raw field original and measurement source remain independently retained; every transformation identifies its method and derivative.

relationships.name: facts_judgments_evidence
relationships.integrity: Fact establishment is an authorized human decision; observation, statement, inference and fact remain separately typed. Contradictions can dispute an established fact.

relationships.name: risk_receptors
relationships.integrity: Risk is potential; an observed impact is separately linked to Activity, receptor, baseline and observation.

relationships.name: baseline_receptor
relationships.integrity: Multiple seasonal/temporal baselines may coexist. Do not substitute a recent measurement for the prior baseline.

relationships.name: plan_measures
relationships.integrity: One logical plan-measure relationship, explicit mitigation hierarchy, responsibilities, budget, schedule and verification criteria.

relationships.name: measures_risks_impacts
relationships.integrity: Measures address explicit risks/impacts; mitigation completion does not by itself establish outcome effectiveness.

relationships.name: program_cycles
relationships.integrity: All cycles reuse existing approved baseline, requirements, indicators, submissions, findings and actions. Overlap is allowed and explicit.

relationships.name: indicator_measurements
relationships.integrity: Measurement retains site, period, unit, worker/group dimension, denominator, method/QA and source; no aggregation across incompatible definitions.

relationships.name: social_outcomes
relationships.integrity: Compare against explicit baseline and indicators; retain disaggregation and limits to attributing outcome to project.

relationships.name: consultation_commitments
relationships.integrity: Feedback, response, accessibility, disclosure timing and deviations are evidence; no automatic judgment of meaningful consultation.

relationships.name: entitlement_delivery
relationships.integrity: Partial and repeated delivery are retained with money, dates, evidence and verification. Payment is not livelihood restoration.

relationships.name: finding_actions
relationships.integrity: Action retains underlying deficiency, owner, deadline, budget and dependencies; closure requires authorized verification of retained evidence.

relationships.name: commitment_actions
relationships.integrity: A commitment can need several actions; one action can fulfill several commitments without duplicating authority.

relationships.name: case_actions
relationships.integrity: Sensitive personal facts and geometry remain in existing restricted case authority; redaction follows transitive source/geometry closure.

relationships.name: action_verification
relationships.integrity: A failed verification may reopen an action; verifier identity and authority are checked against current roles.

relationships.name: assessment_approval
relationships.integrity: Approvals pin exact immutable content revision/hash and professional authority; imported local attestations never become hosted verified identity.

relationships.name: baseline_reports
relationships.integrity: Many institutional reports are derived views of one frozen dataset and mapping version; report fields do not become authoritative duplicates.

integrityRules.rule: Stable application IDs survive renames, export/import, physical storage moves and template changes. UUIDs for new records; exact historical opaque IDs preserved.
Project bindings must resolve through current explicit canonical identity links. The same identity may have multiple account project facets; facets never merge by name.
Organization identity is explicit. Existing stakeholder labels and accountCustodyIds are descriptive candidates, not verified organizations or access grants.

Every current internal ID resolves to exactly one expected entity type in the permitted account/project scope; reject dangling refs and type confusion in the current graph. Historical snapshots receive structural/schema and digest checks; these checks do not prove that archived external authority existed, was authorized, or retained exact bytes at the claimed past time.
integrityRules.enforcement: current transactional graph authority validator; history structural/hash validation only

integrityRules.rule: Component containment, parent investment, parent facility and action dependency graphs are acyclic. A component parent shares projectId.
All component/site scopes, allocation components, covenant components and engagement scopes agree with their referenced Project.
An engagement/cycle/event/action/baseline reference must resolve in its existing owning engagement and project; a baseline hash must equal the existing retained baseline hash.
Logical inverse relationships are one edge, not competing authorities. AgreementFacility and ComponentSite have normalized joins in the proposed relational model.
Financial amounts are exact decimal strings with explicit ISO currency; no floating-point totals or silent currency conversion.

Allocation percentages and comparable participant shares cannot exceed 100 in any overlapping effective-date partition. Allocation amounts cannot exceed the attributable original-currency investment total within that partition. Sequential non-overlapping allocations are not summed as simultaneous exposure.
integrityRules.enforcement: exact decimal sums + explicit effective-date/currency partitions; verify with period-boundary acceptance

integrityRules.rule: Never add fund/intermediary parent exposures and their subinvestments as independent economic exposure. Distinguish original amount, outstanding, committed and disbursed.
integrityRules.enforcement: explicit reporting measure and consolidation boundary

integrityRules.rule: Partial allocations and unknown amounts are represented as missing/unallocated values; unknown never becomes zero. Mixed currencies and estimated values are flagged in reports.
integrityRules.enforcement: bounded slice report + future portfolio reporting

integrityRules.rule: Activity.sectorProfileId must resolve through existing getSectorProfile in src/lib/sector-risk-profiles.js. It is a manually reviewed application classification, not an institutional E&S category. Sector exposure uses verified scoped activities for effective leaf allocations at their component/project scope; missing or multiple candidate profiles remain unknown rather than being guessed. asOf filters financial allocation validity only.
integrityRules.enforcement: existing profile registry lookup + explicit verification + bounded allocation-effective-date aggregation

integrityRules.rule: effectiveFrom<=effectiveTo; periodStart<=periodEnd; event occurrence, assessment, awareness, notification, record and approval times are distinct. No date inferred from upload.
Late lifecycle entry is allowed; completed predecessors are never fabricated. Repeated and overlapping assessments/cycles preserve independent period and version IDs.

The limited report asOf selector filters financial allocation effective dates only. Assessment context is an explicitly referenced retained approved baseline or a current working-review projection; it is not a reconstruction of all knowledge/authority as of a past date. Full effective-time plus recorded-time querying remains gated design work.
integrityRules.enforcement: ReportTemporalScope constant contract + explicit assessment context/source hash selection

integrityRules.rule: CAS expectedRevision protects each mutation. Record revision and root ledger revision increase monotonically; server-owned actor/time fields cannot be forged on upsert.

History snapshots retain exact prior business contexts, with structural validation, verified digests and a complete revision sequence. Hashes establish internal retained-content consistency, not independent origin, past authority, original source custody or a trusted timestamp. Corrections create new revisions and never edit approved bytes.
integrityRules.enforcement: snapshot structural/hash and history chain checks; fresh current local verification before new approval

integrityRules.rule: Approved business-context snapshots freeze only ledger context. They never replace engagement baselines, grant source access or establish compliance.
Approved engagement assessment snapshots retain original content, schema interpretation, source pins, approval/audit chains and original hashes; additive projection defaults do not rewrite them.

All current citation/source references pin project/resource/version plus full-object hash and resolve current source authority. Exact bytes and declared integrity are checked before local verification/new business approval. Historical source-pin structure and snapshot digests alone cannot prove archived original bytes or past source authority; existing engagement evidence/custody rules remain separate.
integrityRules.enforcement: current source authority and retained-byte verification; explicitly limited historical claims

integrityRules.rule: Composite document integrity is not a full-object SHA256. Preserve shared DocumentVersionLink integrity.type and its exact algorithm metadata; do not relabel COMPOSITE as FULL_OBJECT.
OCR, extraction and spatial derivatives retain exact original source/version/hash, transformation version and derivative identity. OCR quote eligibility requires existing original-page human review.
Observation records what was measured or seen. EvidenceAssertion states what an exact source supports. ProfessionalJudgment interprets. ProjectFact requires explicit authorized human establishment.
integrityRules.enforcement: separate entity types and sign-off policy

integrityRules.rule: Human verification means the stated proposition and source binding were checked; it is not a legal signature, source ownership or framework compliance conclusion.
AI/extracted/imported candidates remain unreviewed until an authorized human verifies them. Preserve model/method, prompt hash, exact sources, uncertainty and rejection history.
Every institutional requirement is edition-specific, attributable and labeled authoritative_text/review_prompt/paraphrase. A review prompt is never relabeled as authoritative policy text.
integrityRules.enforcement: retained catalogue wording and source validation

integrityRules.rule: Requirement applicability is scoped to Project/component/financing/agreement/period and has a rationale and accountable assessor. Framework selection alone is not applicability.
Crosswalks use explicit directed relations between exact editions. No relation, including equivalent, transfers applicability, adequacy, compliance or approval conclusions.
Evidence coverage, adequacy, applicability, implementation, effectiveness and compliance/performance remain independent fields. Missing evidence does not become a definitive noncompliance conclusion.
Measurements require explicit unit, period, method, QA, detection-limit/uncertainty where relevant, and denominator before ratios or aggregation; never compare incomparable populations.
Grievance/incident personal content and sensitive geometry use existing restricted case controls. Public/search/report projection observes source and geometry protection closure.
Incident occurrence, organization awareness and each lender/regulator notification are separate timestamps with sourced deadline rules.
Descriptive roles, external institutional identifiers, imported attestations and reference links never grant access. All reads/writes, index retrieval and exports re-evaluate current host authority.
Local loopback account isolation and professional declared roles are distinct from hosted authenticated user/resource grants; do not claim hosted authorization for the new local ledger.
Extensions use a registered namespace, pinned schema URI/version, bounded JSON and safe keys. Core relationships, approval, actor and source identity cannot be overridden by extensions.
Exchange round-trip preserves IDs, original currency/decimals, missing values, exact source pins, extension payloads, content revision, history, digests and approval semantics.

Imports validate referenced current authorities, current retained original-byte proof, complete historical structure and digest consistency atomically before commit. Imported history does not independently prove past authority/custody or create local verification receipts. Same ID+revision with different content is a conflict; exact duplicate import is idempotent.
integrityRules.enforcement: atomic same-account empty restore or exact replay; current authority/byte checks; history structural/hash checks

integrityRules.rule: No hosted worker, recurring schedule, queue consumer or physical database replacement is introduced by this design. Explicit manual jobs have byte/request/time limits and a stop condition.

observation.meaning: What an identified observer measured or directly saw at a stated time using a stated method.
observation.example: Noise meter reported a particular dB value at a named site/time.
observation.cannotInfer: Whether the legal averaging-period limit is exceeded or the project is compliant.

evidenceAssertion.meaning: A quoted exact source passage supports a particular statement, with provenance and human review status.
evidenceAssertion.example: A retained monitoring report states its consultant measured a particular value.
evidenceAssertion.cannotInfer: The consultant measurement is correct, representative, independent or sufficient.

professionalJudgment.meaning: An attributable professional interprets observations/evidence using scoped criteria and explicit uncertainty/contradictions.
professionalJudgment.example: Assessor judges evidence insufficient to evaluate permit compliance for the reporting period.
professionalJudgment.cannotInfer: A judgment under another framework or later period.

establishedFact.meaning: An authorized human explicitly establishes a scoped proposition on retained support, with correction/dispute history.
establishedFact.example: The approved as-built plan and site verification establish the location of a component as of a stated date.
establishedFact.cannotInfer: Timeless certainty or irrevocability; later evidence can dispute/correct it.

epistemicModel.promotion: No automatic promotion between layers. A new human-authored decision records its exact input refs, rationale, scope and date while preserving the original layers.

workflows.name: Project origination and scoping
workflows.entry: May start with an already operating project; unknown historical dates remain unknown.
workflows.reuse: Existing canonical identity + account project; map external identifiers and explicit component hierarchy without creating another Project.
workflows.humanGate: Confirm identity match, custody and intended scope.

workflows.name: E&S screening and categorization
workflows.entry: Can occur for a new investment, subinvestment, expansion or periodic rescreening.
workflows.reuse: Same Project, source editions and requirements; screening judgment is scoped and edition-specific.
outputs: Screening assessment and reasoned risk/category decision
workflows.humanGate: Authorized assessor verifies evidence and classification rubric; AI proposes only.

workflows.name: Due diligence and gap analysis
workflows.entry: Repeated and overlapping disciplines/mandates are valid.
workflows.reuse: Requirements, exact sources and assertions stay in their existing engagement authority; multiple lenders derive their own findings.
workflows.humanGate: Independent review and original-source confirmation; no cross-framework conclusion transfer.

workflows.name: Appraisal and investment approval
workflows.entry: Financier appraisal may overlap or follow another lender decision.
workflows.reuse: Freeze exact assessment baseline and business-context snapshot separately.
workflows.humanGate: Current approver authority and scope-specific evidence; a business-ledger approval is not E&S approval.

workflows.name: Financial commitment and closing
workflows.entry: One Project may close several facilities/transactions at different times.
workflows.reuse: Agreements pin retained originals; covenants link existing requirements and monitoring obligations.
workflows.humanGate: Verify signed agreement editions, parties, amounts, conditions and applicability; preserve estimated/unknown values.

workflows.name: Construction and implementation monitoring
workflows.entry: Monitoring can begin before every financing closes; components have different schedules.
workflows.reuse: Program derives from the existing approved baseline, carrying forward requirement/source/action IDs with new cycle findings.
workflows.humanGate: Review QA and completeness, protect case data, verify action evidence before closure.

workflows.name: Operational supervision
workflows.entry: May be the first recorded phase for a mature project; no invented earlier assessments.
workflows.reuse: Three or more successive cycles reuse indicators/requirements/commitments but freeze independent evidence and professional judgments.
outputs: Comparable performance trends with explicit denominators
workflows.humanGate: Evaluate effectiveness and residual risk separately from implementation or paperwork completion.

workflows.name: Project restructuring and expansion
workflows.entry: Can overlap operations/construction and trigger repeat screening/due diligence.
workflows.reuse: Same real-world identity unless an explicit identity determination says otherwise; add new components/financial revisions and preserve prior effective periods.
workflows.humanGate: Explicitly reassess applicability and source/requirement editions; no automatic carry-forward of compliance.

workflows.name: Financial exit and closure
workflows.entry: Financier exit and physical project closure are distinct and can occur in different years.
workflows.reuse: Financial status changes do not delete continuing social/environmental obligations or project identity.
outputs: Exit transaction and residual obligation view
Closure assessment with evidence and open commitments
workflows.humanGate: Identify unresolved obligations and funded responsibility; financial repayment is not environmental or social closure.

workflows.name: Post-closure outcome verification
workflows.entry: A new verification engagement may be recorded years after lender exit.
workflows.reuse: Compare new retained observations against original baselines and commitments while preserving dates, source versions and attribution limits.
outputs: Public or restricted evidence-governed reporting view
workflows.humanGate: Independent evidence review; distinguish verified outcome from causal inference and past compliance.

disciplineProfiles.name: Biodiversity and ecosystem services
validation: Retain survey season, effort, spatial method and uncertainty.
Critical habitat determination and offset adequacy are professional judgments with attributable rubric/source.
Restrict sensitive species coordinates.

disciplineProfiles.name: Air, water, soil, noise and pollution
validation: Do not compare instantaneous readings to incompatible averaging-period limits.
Preserve censored/below-detection results in a typed profile extension until Quantity supports them directly.
Flag qualified/rejected laboratory results.

disciplineProfiles.name: Climate, energy, water and resource efficiency
validation: Factor/scenario/method versions and original units remain explicit.
Separate estimated values and uncertainty from verified inventory data.
No implicit carbon credit or climate-alignment conclusion.

disciplineProfiles.name: Labor, working conditions and occupational health
validation: Fatalities/injury counts and rates use explicit worker population and exposure hours.
Protect health/union/complainant details using existing case authority.
Labor conformity is not inferred from absence of complaints.

disciplineProfiles.name: Land acquisition, displacement and livelihood restoration
validation: Individual rosters and valuation details remain restricted.
Payment completion does not establish livelihood restoration.
Retain inflation/price basis, denominator and follow-up period for comparisons.

disciplineProfiles.name: Indigenous peoples and culturally appropriate engagement
validation: Consent/FPIC judgments require the exact applicable framework conditions and professional review.
Do not infer consent from attendance or silence.
Apply culturally sensitive access and retention controls.

disciplineProfiles.name: Community health, safety and security
validation: Separate occurrence, awareness and reporting deadlines.
Survivor/victim pointers remain restricted.
Serious-event categorization and reporting obligations are sourced judgments.

disciplineProfiles.name: Cultural heritage
validation: Protect sacred/archaeological location data.
Keep chance-find observations distinct from expert significance determinations.

disciplineProfiles.name: Stakeholder engagement, disclosure and grievance response
validation: Document disclosure timing and accessibility; evaluate adequacy separately.
Never expose participant or complainant identities in ordinary reports/search.
Retain responses and unresolved feedback rather than count attendance as effectiveness.

disciplineProfiles.name: Financial intermediaries, funds and portfolios
validation: No double count of fund investment and financed subprojects.
No mixed-currency or mixed-date percentages without explicit conversion/denominator rules.
Aggregate disclosure observes underlying project/case authorization.

disciplineProfiles.name: Waste and hazardous materials
validation: Retain exact disposal/manifest sources and original units.
A shipping record is evidence of transfer, not proof of safe final disposal.

disciplineProfiles.name: Cumulative impacts, closure and post-closure outcomes
validation: Separate financial exit, physical closure and fulfillment of long-term obligations.
Retain baseline and counterfactual limitations; outcome trends do not prove causation.

identifiers.application: Stable existing opaque IDs; UUIDs for newly created entities. Preserve IDs across round-trip, rename, storage move and report views.
identifiers.external: {namespace: absolute URI, value: original identifier, label?: text}; allow multiple institutional aliases, retain publisher/edition in relevant requirement/source entities.
identifiers.authorityReferences: Use unchanged shared ResourceReference shape with authority, resource_id, resource_type, workspace_id and exact version_id when frozen.

timeDimensions.effectiveFrom/effectiveTo: Inclusive calendar validity of a role, relationship or business record; missing end means no recorded end, not verified current truth. Overlapping allocation/participant ceilings are checked at all interval boundaries.
timeDimensions.eventAt/occurredAt: When a real-world milestone, incident or observation occurred.
timeDimensions.recordedAt: When the system recorded a business event, independent of occurrence.
timeDimensions.assessedAt/assessmentDate: When an assessor made the scoped professional judgment.
timeDimensions.approvedAt/decidedAt: When an authorized human approved exact immutable content.
timeDimensions.source capturedAt/publishedOn/documentDa: Distinct source acquisition/publication/document dates; upload does not establish event or policy effective date.
timeDimensions.limitedReport.asOf: Financial allocation effective date only, default current UTC calendar date. Report.temporalScope explicitly denies historical-knowledge reconstruction. Assessment selection remains an explicit retained baseline or current review.
timeDimensions.futureBitemporalQuery: A complete effective_at + known_at read profile, including historical authority/source closure, is proposed and disabled until durable provenance and query semantics are validated.

historicalRecords.revisionPolicy: CAS per ledger mutation; server-owned actor/time; full prior snapshots and append-only audit chain. New fact/requirement/document editions get explicit supersession/correction relationships rather than destructive overwrite.

approvedSnapshots.existingAssessment: Retain exact existing baseline envelope/content/hash, complete original histories/audit, source versions and authorization interpretation. Do not rewrite approved bytes for optional additive arrays or display defaults.
approvedSnapshots.businessContext: Canonical snapshot={context,revision,projects,entities,extensions}; SHA256 over defined stable JSON excluding sha256 field. Store approvedBy/At/statement separately; revision is pinned content revision.
approvedSnapshots.hashSemantics: Use the existing stableJson recursive key-sort convention for ledger JSON; UTF-8 JSON without whitespace. Arrays preserve order. Require finite portable JSON and exact decimal strings; this is not claimed to be RFC 8785 or a legal signature.

historicalRecords.corrections: Append a correction event with target record/revision, reason, replacement revision and exact affected snapshots. Approved old content stays readable under its original authority; do not silently rebase historical reports.

validationBoundary.implementedCurrent: Current graph uses existing Project/identity/engagement/framework/source authority lookups on read/write/import; current source bytes are verified for explicit local verification and new business approval.
validationBoundary.implementedHistorical: Full shape/structural validation and complete snapshot/audit digest/sequence consistency. Archived snapshots are retained exact content under their original recorded interpretation.
notProvenByHashes: Independent origin or authenticity of imported historical assertions.
Past account participation, source grants, professional role authority or trusted event/record time.
Availability or integrity of archived original bytes that are no longer in the current retained-source graph.
Professional E&S approval or compliance; business approval has a separate scope.
validationBoundary.freshApproval: An import retains historical verification/approval claims as history. A new approval requires fresh local verification receipts for exact current record hashes and current retained-source byte proof; imported fields cannot create those receipts.
validationBoundary.futureDurableAuthorityGate: Before claiming historical authority/custody verification, define and validate native versioned authority export manifests, original retained-source/archive closure, issuer/identity verification and trusted approval provenance. These checks are proposed and are not established by a self-consistent JSON hash chain.

provenanceRules.human: Identify acting user/local actor, method, record date and exact supporting sources; manual entry is not inherently verified.
provenanceRules.import: Record source system/export edition, batch ID, original IDs, transformation/mapping version and source hash in registered provenance extension when not core. Validate in scratch transaction.
provenanceRules.extraction: Record extractor/method version, exact source edition/hash, passage/range/page and derivative identity; candidate remains unreviewed.
provenanceRules.ai: Identify model/method and prompt hash with exact inputs and limitations; user verification is separate, server-controlled and attributable. AI cannot approve content or grant access.
provenanceRules.quality: Retain review status, representativeness, completeness, QA, uncertainty, independence and contradictory evidence. Verified source binding does not mean sufficient professional evidence.

storageAndInteroperability.decision: Specify logical relational/spatial/object/search interfaces before selecting or deploying a physical replacement. Existing SQLite JSON/local files and authenticated object persistence remain current authorities.

relationalCore.keyPolicy: tenant_account_id + stable entity ID; explicit ProjectBinding references existing account project and identity. Composite foreign keys enforce tenancy/type/project closure; application checks add graph cycles and current authority checks.

tables.name: lifecycle_ledger
tables.purpose: One current business-context extension per account; not a new Project authority.

tables.name: lifecycle_project_binding
tables.purpose: Projection/reference of existing identity link, validated against its authority; not independent identity matching.

tables.name: project_component
tables.purpose: Nested/associated physical component; scoped parent FK and cycle guard.

tables.name: site / activity / component_site / activity_site
tables.purpose: Normalized site/activity scope and joins; geometry held in versioned spatial profile. sector_profile_id references an adapter pin to the existing app sector-profile registry, not an institutional category.

tables.name: organization / organization_role_assignment
tables.purpose: Explicit business identity and time-bounded roles; no resource access grants.

tables.name: investment / financial_facility / financial_transaction
tables.purpose: Separate economic interest, contractual financing and flows; exact numeric SQL DECIMAL/NUMERIC scale policy.

tables.name: financing_participant / investment_allocation
tables.purpose: Multiple financiers and cross-project/component allocation; partition aggregation by scope/time/currency.

tables.name: agreement / agreement_party / agreement_project / agreement_facility / covenant
tables.purpose: Single normalized edge per relationship and pinned contract/covenant sources.

tables.name: engagement_scope / requirement_applicability / lifecycle_event
tables.purpose: Scope overlay and lifecycle links into current engagement/requirement/monitoring authority.

tables.name: external_reference / registered_extension / source_reference
tables.purpose: Namespaced interoperable references and typed bounded extensions; never opaque relationship replacement.

tables.name: lifecycle_record_revision / ledger_history / ledger_approval_snapshot / audit_event
tables.purpose: Append-only history and approved business snapshots independent of existing assessment baselines.

tables.name: future risk/receptor/impact/baseline/measure/outcome joins
tables.purpose: Deploy only after bounded domain slices and authorization/provenance validation; no generic EAV replacement of core relationships.

relationalCore.transactions: Validate current external authorities, tenant scope, graph closure, decimal balances and expectedRevision, then atomically append history/audit and commit current content. No partially imported graph or deferred privileged source resolution.

spatialProfile.runtime: Site optional WGS84 latitude/longitude pair + exact geometrySource reference. Existing source geometry edit/derivation authority remains unchanged.
spatialProfile.proposed: Versioned GeoJSON geometry/FeatureCollection as retained source objects; relational spatial-feature metadata holds stable feature ID, project/component/site/receptor refs, bbox, source edition/hash, CRS/transformation method/version, effective period and sensitivity.
spatialProfile.coordinatePolicy: GeoJSON output uses WGS84 longitude/latitude order. Preserve original CRS/coordinates and full transformation provenance when importing; never silently relabel a projected CRS. Use explicit antimeridian and invalid-polygon handling.
spatialProfile.storageOptions: Local GeoJSON + bounded bbox index; self-hosted SQLite spatial extension or PostgreSQL/PostGIS after measured need; managed equivalent behind same adapter. No PostGIS dependency is imposed on local mode.
spatialProfile.authorization: Geometry disclosure follows existing source/case protection closure. Public generalized locations are separately reviewed derived projections, never in-place edits of sensitive originals.

evidenceObjectContract.authority: Existing project resources/versions + unchanged shared DocumentVersionLink; exact bytes stay in existing object/source custody.
evidenceObjectContract.reference: ExactSourceVersion projectId/resourceId/versionId/full-object sha256 resolves existing descriptor; interop carries shared authority/workspace/document/version + integrity type, size and media type.
evidenceObjectContract.integrity: Verify full bytes/length and declared integrity before reuse; preserve COMPOSITE part semantics when present. Do not substitute a source title, download URL or matching filename for exact identity.
evidenceObjectContract.transport: No absolute filesystem paths, signed URLs, credentials, capability grants or source bytes in lifecycle JSON. Authorized byte retrieval remains the existing mediated source endpoint.
evidenceObjectContract.archival: Manual bounded idempotent intake; reuse verified retained bytes, explicit refresh only. Retention/deletion holds follow current source and approval policy; never delete a source required by an approved assessment.
evidenceObjectContract.derivatives: Text/OCR/spatial/previews/search indices are replaceable derived artifacts with original source hash and transform version. They cannot replace retained originals or grant citation eligibility.

searchAndRetrieval.authority: Derived index only; existing local evidence extraction/index limits and current source authorization remain in force.
searchAndRetrieval.content: Lexical/spatial/optional semantic features over authorized projected metadata and exact passages. Exclude restricted personal/case content unless explicitly authorized and correctly partitioned.
searchAndRetrieval.retrieval: Recheck current account/source/case grants and source version/hash at query and fetch. Return candidate refs/passages with method/coverage/limits; similarity is not evidence, fact, applicability or compliance.
searchAndRetrieval.invalidation: Explicit source selection/revision/profile/authorization changes invalidate derived cache keys. Build on demand with byte/time/count ceilings; no background polling consumer.

jsonSchemaInterfaces.proposedDefinitions: All remaining domain entities remain design-only or explicit existing-authority projections. Adding a new definition does not allow it as a LedgerEntities collection.
jsonSchemaInterfaces.shapeVsSemantics: JSON Schema covers keys/types/enums/bounds and selected paired fields. Runtime must enforce current authority/FKs/cycles, period order, decimal sums, identity, approval authority, exact histories/hashes and source bytes.

localSlice.authority: Existing loopback account selection and guards; actor metadata is local process attribution. No new remote authentication claim.
localSlice.read: GET current ledger; response is strict ProjectLifecycleExchange. Missing ledger yields an empty account-scoped projection without inventing Project/source entities.
localSlice.commands: POST commands using expectedRevision and one explicit mutation; server controls IDs/revisions/actor/time/verification. Stale revision =>409, malformed fields/refs=>400, scope denial=>403/404, bounded size violation=>413.
localSlice.exchange: Explicit export/import with current authority/source closure plus complete structural/hash-validated history/audit/business approvals. Historical origin/authority is not proven by hashes. Validate atomically before empty-ledger restore; exact duplicate import is idempotent.
localSlice.report: Bounded read-derived report over one ledger revision and current-authorized refs. asOf selects financial allocation validity only; assessmentContexts pin a retained approved baseline or current working review with separate projection hashes. Report.temporalScope explicitly states no historical knowledge reconstruction. InstitutionView is a partial minimized field exchange with all compliance flags false.
localSlice.approval: Business snapshot approval pins exact LedgerSnapshot hash/revision and requires fresh installation-local current-record verification; cannot approve an existing assessment or imply framework compliance.

proposedHosted.authorization: Use existing verified identity/resource grants with tenant-scoped current authority on every read/write/export/search; IDs and imported roles never grant access.
proposedHosted.concurrency: ETag content revision + If-Match for mutation; optional Idempotency-Key scoped to account+actor+operation+body hash.
proposedHosted.pagination: Cursor-bound account/project filters with deterministic order, explicit page limit and total byte cap; no unbounded list or cross-tenant scan.
proposedHosted.errors: Stable {code,message,requestId,details} without private IDs/paths; 409 for CAS/content conflict; preserve redaction boundaries.
proposedHosted.versionNegotiation: application/vnd.esia.project-lifecycle+json; schemaVersion=1. Fail closed for unsupported write schema; allow explicit versioned read adapters only.
proposedHosted.events: After commit, append audit/outbox event in the same transaction; delivery adapter optional and bounded. Do not deploy event transport until volume/idle/stop policy is known.

eventAndAuditContract.runtime: LedgerAuditEvent is append-only {id,sequence,revision,command:{type,collection?,recordId?,statement?,resultSha256},actorId,recordedAt,previousSha256,sha256}; verify complete chain and command.resultSha256 linkage to the actual resulting snapshot. The audit chain detects tampering within retained data; it is not an external timestamp service or legal digital signature.
eventAndAuditContract.delivery: At-least-once only if an outbox adapter is later enabled; idempotent event consumers key by eventId+schemaVersion and recheck authorization. No idle consumer or schedule in current implementation.

extensions.shape: { namespace:key: {schema:absoluteURI,schemaVersion:positiveInteger,value:boundedJSON} } using safe namespace:key keys. Registry owns allowlist, schemas, migrators and visibility/retention policy.
rules: Core IDs, actor/revision, source integrity, scopes, access and approval semantics cannot be overridden.
New cross-entity relationships belong in typed canonical fields/joins, not extension free text.
A generic external template field can be retained only with its exact template/field provenance and an explicit unresolved mapping.
Imports reject/quarantine unsupported write namespaces/versions; known payload round-trip is exact.
No code, function invocation, HTML execution, local paths, credentials or signed transports.
extensions.promotion: A repeatedly useful extension becomes a reviewed canonical attribute through an explicit versioned migration with a reversible mapping and old payload retained for provenance.

importExportRoundTrip.content: Preserve all stable IDs/revisions, exact source refs/hashes, namespaced aliases, original decimals/currencies, temporal dimensions, missing-vs-zero, complete histories/approved snapshots/audit and registered extension payloads.
validationOrder: Current internal refs and type/scope closure; historical snapshot structural checks without claiming historical external authority
Canonical snapshot digests and complete audit/history; hashes do not prove independent origin
Current actor/source/case authorization and current retained-source byte proof; imported review claims do not create local receipts
Atomic CAS commit or explicit no-change idempotent import
importExportRoundTrip.transforms: Every institution import/export mapping has a pinned template edition, field path, canonical attribute, transformation version, unit/currency/terminology conversion and validation result. Unresolvable values stay explicit; never fabricate evidence or compliance.

deploymentCompatibility.current: Existing Node/SQLite/private files, on-demand bounded operations and loopback account guards.
deploymentCompatibility.interface: Same application IDs, JSON Schema, exact source links and adapters.
deploymentCompatibility.limit: No hosted identity/access guarantee; declared local actor/roles retain explicit labels.

deploymentCompatibility.interface: Relational/object/search adapters can use local filesystem, S3-compatible object storage and PostgreSQL or SQLite with explicit auth host.
deploymentCompatibility.limit: Requires verified identity/resource authorization adapter and tested backup/migration policy before enablement.

deploymentCompatibility.current: Existing authenticated application has its own object/access adapters; new lifecycle hosted adapter is proposed.
deploymentCompatibility.interface: Same business/schema API over managed relational/object/search providers; never embed AWS IDs/paths as business identity.
deploymentCompatibility.limit: No new queues/workers/schedules; cost estimate, request budget, idle behavior and bounded stop condition before any hosted background operation.

migrationAndBackwardCompatibility.principle: Additive extension; preserve all current Project/document/identity/evidence authorities and approved assessment bytes. No deployment or destructive physical migration in this architecture artifact.

stages.action: Inventory and pin existing authority/schema versions; take bounded local export/hash fixtures.
stages.gate: Current approved baseline/source/export conformance passes without transformation.

stages.action: Add the account-owned lifecycle business ledger and strict typed envelope; default absence to no ledger in a read projection.
stages.gate: Existing workspace/project export formats and approved snapshots remain byte-identical; no invented records.

stages.action: Create explicit ProjectBinding from verified current account/identity link; let users add structured organizations/components/financing.
stages.gate: No name-based merge; multi-project investment allocation and cross-scope rejection demonstrated.

stages.action: Offer manual preview of existing stakeholder/lifecycle metadata and engagement deliverable/free-text dates as candidates.
stages.gate: Explicit reconciliation/promotion map preserves original values and IDs; ambiguous organization/source/time stays unmapped.

stages.action: Add read adapters for existing engagement/assertion/finding/action/monitoring/source references and template views.
stages.gate: Current scope + source/case authorization rechecked; no copied evidence authority.

stages.action: Introduce proposed E&S domain records one bounded vertical slice at a time after domain-specific validation.
stages.gate: Typed registered profiles, original-source provenance and human workflow demonstrated.

stages.action: Select physical relational/spatial persistence only after query volume, access patterns, tenancy and migration/rollback evidence justify it.
stages.gate: Rehearsed dry run, counts/ID/hash reconciliation, idempotence and read rollback; no automatic data conversion or cloud deployment.

stages.action: Implement hosted authorization adapter and institution/report connectors only through explicit capability contracts.
stages.gate: Native current-authority security tests and cost-bounded operational review pass before hosted enablement.

legacyHandling.sourceProjects: Retain esia-local-project package versions and schema reader floors; new ledger uses independently versioned exchange, not an implicit bump of every source-project snapshot.
legacyHandling.engagements: Keep esia-engagement-package/exchange/snapshot v1 and current optional monitoring/register semantics. Proposed new fields need explicit additive contract/version plan; never smuggle them into approved snapshots.
legacyHandling.stakeholders: Existing lifecycle[]/stakeholders[] stay descriptive. A user can promote to new structured IDs while keeping source links and ambiguity; no automatic account-to-organization equivalence.
legacyHandling.unknownFields: Reject unknown core fields. Preserve known registered extension payloads exactly; unsupported namespace/version imports are read-only/quarantined or fail atomically, never silently discarded.
legacyHandling.oldReaders: Old applications must not write newer ledger contracts. Explicit schemaVersion capability negotiation and export adapter required; old source/engagement readers remain unaffected.

migrationAndBackwardCompatibility.rollback: Disable new ledger routes/views and retain additive ledger bytes. Do not downgrade or rewrite source documents, existing project data or approved baselines. A future physical migration requires backup + restore rehearsal and a reader-floor policy.

featureGates.enablement: Local loopback account context; requires current Project/identity/engagement/source adapters and strict CAS/history/source checks.
featureGates.validation: Three isolated local acceptance scenarios, schema export/import round-trip, original approved-record preservation, authorization rejection and bounded performance.

featureGates.enablement: A separate domain slice must add explicit typed schemas/adapters/authorization and human review process. Adding a proposed $defs type does not enable writes.
featureGates.validation: Discipline-specific provenance, observation/evidence/judgment/fact separation, restricted-source closure and immutable baseline tests.

featureGates.enablement: Exact versioned institution template adapters, validated transformed fields and explicit unresolved mappings.
featureGates.validation: Same canonical IDs across multiple real template formats, independent evidence/rubric review, no invented or automatically transferred compliance conclusion.

featureGates.enablement: Measured need, selected physical profile, dry-run reconciliation and explicit controlled migration implementation.
featureGates.validation: ID/count/hash reconciliation, FK/tenant/time/currency invariants, idempotence, backup/restore and rollback rehearsal.

featureGates.enablement: Verified native principal/resource grants, explicit hosting adapter and deployment configuration; no caller-controlled actor authority.
featureGates.validation: Negative cross-tenant/case/source access, current authorization per read/export/search, cost/request budgets and bounded idle/stop behavior before any optional worker.

incrementalBacklog.scope: Limited local business ledger and Project references
Three isolated local acceptance scenarios and derived institutional report views
Read-only E&S graph adapters over existing engagement authority
Versioned institutional requirement/applicability and crosswalk adapters
Relational/spatial persistence selection and migration rehearsal

acceptance: Bounded request volume and stop conditions

incrementalBacklog.scope: Durable historical authority/custody and bitemporal query profile
acceptance: Native attributable authority export manifests and exact archived-source closure
Historical grants/role interpretation and approval provenance verified independently of JSON hashes
No claim that the limited financial asOf query reconstructs past assessment knowledge

scenarioA.name: Multi-lender infrastructure investment
required: One existing Project with at least three nested/associated components
Several financing organizations/facilities and separate transactions
At least two existing E&S engagement refs
assertions: Institutional views derive from same IDs

scenarioB.name: Financial intermediary
required: Sector/product exposure and aggregated monitoring mapping

scenarioC.name: Longitudinal supervision
required: Three distinct existing monitoring cycle/baseline refs
Significant existing incident/event and action refs
Restructuring then financial exit/closure and post-closure verification scope
assertions: Earlier snapshots/hashes remain exact after changes
Sources/baseline refs resolve to original authority
Out-of-scope refs and unauthorized mutation/export rejected

acceptanceContract.performance: Benchmark the implemented local profile (<=500 records per collection, <=2000 records total, <=100 project bindings, <=4MiB exchange, <=250 ledger revisions), graph-validation latency and memory locally. Report actual measured results with dataset size; no unmeasured production performance claim.
acceptanceContract.executionPolicy: All development, acceptance fixtures and browser journeys are local with protected APIs blocked. No AWS commands, production queue receives, live app writes, hosted workers or recurring jobs are required.
